_comment: Wireless Layer B authorized-access-point allowlist. Fill from the client's own inventory of legitimate corporate SSIDs and the BSSIDs (radio MACs) of their sanctioned access points. WirelessAirImport.py flags any radio broadcasting a corporate ESSID whose BSSID is NOT listed here as a rogue/evil-twin candidate. An incomplete list produces false rogue findings, so confirm it with the client before the capture.
